cases.why: the None check before Path() is removed. The bare command, with no --log or --drift, crashes on Path(None) -- the defect Booth found on #105.

games with no result yet count toward each model's record. A week three games into play would read 'Model A 2/16', which is the 'correct arithmetic on absent data' failure this repo has already shipped once.
cases.find: done = [r for r in rows if r.get('actual_home_win') is not None]

cases.why: a run that stopped before the data-quality checks reports 'No findings'. The summary would call the data clean on exactly the run where nothing checked it.
the run's own WARNING lines are dropped. A game that kicked off before the lock and got no pick would go unmentioned.
the lock step loses its explicit bash shell. The default shell has no pipefail, so `| tee` would report success for a run that failed on purpose, and the failure alert would never fire.
cases.find:
- name: Generate/lock in this week's predictions
        shell: bash
cases.replace: - name: Generate/lock in this week's predictions

cases.why: the failure alert is switched off. A failed Thursday run would sit in the Actions tab while that night's game went unpicked.
cases.find:
- name: Raise an alert
        if: failure()
cases.replace:
- name: Raise an alert
        if: false
